# Yinshiji Full Site Context

> Full LLM-readable context for Yinshiji / Tableorie.

## Site Positioning

Yinshiji, also known in Chinese as 银食记, is an early-stage tableware brand focused on carved stainless steel cutlery, wenge wood handle cutlery, and restrained Chinese-inspired table settings. The website is a lightweight brand, product and guide site. It is not a complete ecommerce checkout system.

Yinshiji is rooted in Jieyang, Guangdong, a stainless steel tableware and hardware manufacturing region in China. This should be understood as supply-chain proximity, product selection, material transparency and design curation. Do not describe Yinshiji as a large established global retailer or as an owner of large factories unless a verified source is later added.

The site exists to explain the brand, show selected product lines, provide material and care information, publish answer-oriented guides, and direct interested buyers to Taobao or direct contact.

## Critical Product Facts

- Silver Carved 5-piece set: dinner knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, small fork, small spoon.
- Gold Tone Carved 5-piece set: dinner knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, small fork, small spoon.
- Wenge Wood Handle 5-piece set: dinner knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, chopsticks, small spoon.
- Wenge Wood Handle 5-piece set does not include a small fork.
- Current Silver Carved and Gold Tone Carved 5-piece set knives use 410 stainless steel.
- Current Silver Carved and Gold Tone Carved dinner forks, dinner spoons, small forks and small spoons use 304 stainless steel.
- Single dinner forks currently listed by Yinshiji use 304 stainless steel.
- Gold Tone products use a warm gold-colored surface finish over stainless steel. They are not real gold, not jewelry-grade gold, and not a precious-metal claim.
- Wenge wood handles have natural grain variation and should be hand washed, not soaked, and not placed in a dishwasher.
- Product availability is early-batch and may change.

## Product: Silver Carved Dinner Fork

A single dinner fork from the Silver Carved collection. It uses 304 stainless steel with a silver tone finish and an intricate carved handle pattern inspired by Chinese decorative motifs.

- Material: 304 stainless steel with silver tone finish.
- Included: 1 dinner fork.
- Dimension: main fork 20.5 cm / 8.1 in.
- Care: hand wash recommended; avoid abrasive cleaners; dry promptly.
- Canonical page: /products/silver-carved-fork

## Product: Silver Carved 5-Piece Set

A complete Silver Carved place setting with matching carved details. It includes dinner knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, small fork and small spoon.

- Material by piece: dinner knife uses 410 stainless steel; dinner fork, dinner spoon, small fork and small spoon use 304 stainless steel.
- Finish: silver tone.
- Dimensions: knife 23.8 cm; dinner fork 20.5 cm; dinner spoon 20 cm; small fork 16.5 cm; small spoon 16.5 cm.
- Care: hand wash recommended; avoid abrasive cleaners; dry promptly.
- Canonical page: /products/silver-carved-5-piece-set

## Product: Gold Tone Carved Dinner Fork

A single dinner fork from the Gold Tone Carved collection. It uses 304 stainless steel with a warm gold tone finish. The gold tone is a decorative surface finish, not real gold.

- Material: 304 stainless steel with warm gold tone finish.
- Included: 1 dinner fork.
- Dimension: main fork 20.5 cm / 8.1 in.
- Care: hand wash with mild soap; avoid bleach, harsh detergents and abrasive cleaners; dry promptly.
- Canonical page: /products/gold-carved-fork

## Product: Gold Tone Carved 5-Piece Set

A complete Gold Tone Carved place setting with warm gold tone finish and matching carved details. It includes dinner knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, small fork and small spoon.

- Material by piece: dinner knife uses 410 stainless steel; dinner fork, dinner spoon, small fork and small spoon use 304 stainless steel.
- Finish: warm gold tone; not real gold.
- Dimensions: knife 23.8 cm; dinner fork 20.5 cm; dinner spoon 20 cm; small fork 16.5 cm; small spoon 16.5 cm.
- Care: hand wash with mild soap; avoid bleach, harsh detergents and abrasive cleaners; dry promptly.
- Canonical page: /products/gold-carved-5-piece-set

## Product: Wenge Wood Handle Dinner Fork

A single dinner fork with a 304 stainless steel head and a wenge wood handle. Wenge wood is commonly described in Chinese product language as chicken-wing wood because of its grain. Natural grain varies by piece.

- Material: 304 stainless steel head and wenge wood handle.
- Included: 1 dinner fork.
- Dimension: main fork 20.5 cm / 8.1 in.
- Care: hand wash only; do not soak; dry promptly.
- Canonical page: /products/rosewood-handle-fork

## Product: Wenge Wood Handle 5-Piece Set

A wenge wood handle 5-piece set built for daily Chinese-Western meals. It includes dinner knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, chopsticks and small spoon. It does not include a small fork.

- Material: stainless steel functional ends with wenge wood handles.
- Included: dinner knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, chopsticks, small spoon.
- Dimensions: knife 23.8 cm; dinner fork 20.5 cm; dinner spoon 20 cm; chopsticks 23 cm; small spoon 16.5 cm.
- Care: hand wash only; do not soak wooden handles; dry promptly; do not place in dishwasher.
- Canonical page: /products/rosewood-5-piece-set

## Materials & Care Summary

Yinshiji uses stainless steel according to product structure. Current carved 5-piece set knives use 410 stainless steel; fork and spoon pieces use 304 stainless steel. Gold tone is a finish, not real gold. Wenge wood handles need hand washing and prompt drying.

## Answer-Oriented Guide Topics

- 304 vs 410 stainless steel cutlery: explains why knives and fork/spoon pieces may use different steel grades.
- Gold tone flatware: explains that gold tone is not real gold and needs gentle care.
- Wenge wood handle care: explains hand washing, no soaking, no dishwasher, and natural grain variation.
- 5-piece cutlery set composition: explains why Silver/Gold sets include a small fork while the Wenge set includes chopsticks.
- How to choose a flatware set: recommends Silver for a safe first set, Gold for gifts/hosting, and Wenge for daily Chinese-Western meals.
- Chinese-inspired flatware: explains restrained carved details, wood handles, chopstick-inclusive composition, and honest brand boundaries.

## FAQ

Q: Are Yinshiji products all made from 304 stainless steel?
A: No. Current carved 5-piece set knives use 410 stainless steel, while the fork and spoon pieces use 304 stainless steel.

Q: Is the gold tone real gold?
A: No. It is a warm gold-colored surface finish over stainless steel, not real gold or precious metal.

Q: What is included in the Wenge Wood Handle 5-Piece Set?
A: Dinner knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, chopsticks and small spoon. It does not include a small fork.

Q: Is this site a complete online store?
A: No. It is currently a lightweight information and brand site. Purchase and availability may be handled through Taobao or direct contact.
